mcq_fix.s: Match the following rights with the year or date of their recognition by the UN General Assembly. a. Right to development b. Right to water and sanitation c. Right to a clean, healthy and sustainable environment 1. 28 July 2010 2. 28 July 2022 3. 1986 Select the correct combination:
mcq_fix.why: stem garbled: stray 'a. 1986' gave away the answer

pyq_bad.why: suspect key: privacy is protected by UDHR Art 12 and ICCPR Art 17
suspect key: right to work is also a second-generation right; two options correct

patterns: Direct UDHR facts dominate: adopted 10 Dec 1948, Human Rights Day, 30 articles, 'not included' (universal basic income).
APPSC items: UDHR guides SDG agenda; July 2022 UNGA resolution = clean environment a universal human right; Human Rights Day theme (2016); UNHRC Asia-Pacific seats (13).
Generation classification (second generation = economic/social/cultural) and Amnesty International = global human rights movement are recurring.
App adds treaty-ratification status and HRC procedure in multi-statement form - deeper than PYQs but sound.
